name: Roomote
desc: Cloud coding agent that runs on infrastructure you control.
desc_zh: 跑在你自己控制的基础设施上的云端编程智能体。
solves: Hosted agents want your repository and your secrets on someone else’s machine; Roomote keeps the environment yours.
solves_zh: 托管智能体要把你的仓库和密钥放到别人机器上；Roomote 让环境留在你这里。
best_for: Policy forbids your code leaving the network but you still want parallel cloud agents.
best_for_zh: 制度不允许源码离开内网，但你依然想要并行的云端智能体。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — github.com/RooCodeInc/Roomote/releases; B — Hacker News story 2026-04-21）。 The official repository’s first release, v0.0.3, was published 2026-07-11 (GitHub releases index, 127 releases as of 2026-11-25; latest v1.25.0 on 2026-11-24). A Hacker News story dated 2026-04-21 reports the Roo Code team moving to Roomote. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：入库核对：roocode.com 现在跳转到 roomote.dev（标题「Roomote: your own cloud coding agent」）。 账本里的 roo-code 档将标为已改名并指向本档。 首次公开日期来源：https://github.com/RooCodeInc/Roomote/releases/tag/v0.0.3
